2609.20822.title: Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation
2609.20822.paper_summary: Coding agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation: a language model writes the robot controller as a program, and agents built in this way now operate robots without robot-specific training.Whether this paradigm is also safe, however, has not been asked. We evaluate coding agent under a safety constraint, where each task pairs a manipulation goal with an obstacle the robot must not touch. The agent pursues the goal but collides with the obstacle in most cases, treating task completion as its sole objective while neglecting safety. The agent reasons about the obstacle in its traces, and the prompt already forbids touching it, so neither perception nor instruction is at fault; the fault lies in the planning, where the stated constraint never becomes a priority. By decomposing manipulation into a route phase and a contact-rich moment, we locate the source of the failure. Along the route, the model cannot prioritize the safety constraint, having no notion of a clearing route and none of replanning once a chosen route becomes infeasible. At the contact, it is unaware that contact execution is bounded by the same constraint. To close this gap, we present SafeHarness, which equips the model with two obstacle-aware harnesses that enable it to prioritize the safety constraint. Obstacle-aware route planning grounds the objects as bounding boxes and draws candidate routes over them as sequences of waypoints. The agent then plans a route in advance, verifies it, replans when necessary, and only then executes it. Obstacle-aware contact execution instead selects the contact position so that the contact itself avoids the obstacle. SafeHarness attains 71.9% task success and 87.5% collision avoidance, surpassing the previous SOTA by 6.5% and 27.0%, respectively. These results are $2.3\times$ and $1.5\times$ those of the same agent without harnesses.
2609.20822.paper_summary_zh: 編碼代理已成為機器人操作的一個有前景的範式：語言模型將機器人控制器寫成程式，這種方式構建的代理現在能夠在沒有特定於機器人的訓練下操作機器人。然而，這一範式是否也安全，卻尚未被提出。我們在安全約束下評估編碼代理，其中每個任務將操作目標與機器人必須避免接觸的障礙物配對。代理追求目標，但在大多數情況下與障礙物相撞，將任務完成視為唯一目標，忽視安全。代理在其痕跡中對障礙物進行推理，而提示已經禁止接觸它，因此無論是感知還是指令都無法歸咎於此；錯誤在於規劃，所述的約束從未成為優先事項。通過將操作分解為路徑階段和接觸豐富的時刻，我們找到了失敗的根源。在路徑上，模型無法優先考慮安全約束，對清理路徑沒有概念，且一旦選擇的路徑變得不可行就沒有重新規劃。在接觸時，它並不知道接觸執行受到相同約束的限制。為了填補這一空白，我們提出了SafeHarness，該系統為模型配備了兩個障礙物感知的安全帶，使其能夠優先考慮安全約束。障礙物感知路徑規劃將物體作為邊界框進行定位，並在其上繪製候選路徑，作為一系列的路標。然後，代理提前規劃路徑，進行驗證，必要時重新規劃，然後再執行。障礙物感知的接觸執行則選擇接觸位置，以便接觸本身避免障礙物。SafeHarness達到了71.9%的任務成功率和87.5%的碰撞避免率，分別超過了之前的SOTA 6.5%和27.0%。這些結果是沒有安全帶的同一代理的$2.3\times$和$1.5\times$。
